# graceful-shutdown

> Ordered graceful shutdown for Go services: readiness flip, pre-stop delay, phased hooks with per-hook timeouts, panic capture, second-signal force and HTTP draining Go module `github.com/Trysac/u248-graceful-shutdown`, package `gracefulshutdown`, MIT licensed,
> Go >= 1.23, standard library only.
